description: Bounded, source-comparable random edit sequences for v0.3 O1↔V1 certification.

historyRules.undo: Only after at least one conservatively guaranteed edit remains undoable.
historyRules.redo: Only immediately after a generated Undo, with no intervening action.
historyRules.ambiguousEdit: May clear Redo but is never used alone to prove Undo availability.

verticalNavigation.optional: A single terminal ArrowUp or ArrowDown may be added only when marked non-comparable for selection.
